# Smarter.Poker

> Smarter.Poker is a free online poker platform: GTO training, private poker clubs in Poker Arena, Club Commander room management, live venue discovery, home games and a bankroll manager. Free to play, no real-money gambling.

## What this is, and what it is not

Smarter.Poker is operated by Smarter Software Inc. There is no real-money
gambling on the platform. Club chips are play credits with no cash value and
diamonds are a promotional rewards currency. Players compete in Daily 2,000 Chip
Freerolls and Diamond Reward Freerolls with zero entry fees and zero deposit
required. Nothing on the platform is a real-money wager. The platform is free to
play and intended for players aged 18 and over.

The trading name "Smarter Poker" is shared with unrelated businesses. The
entity described in this file is the one at https://smarter.poker, and
https://smarter.poker/about is the page that states it.

## Core Features Across All Fifteen Verticals

### 1. Bankroll Manager & Tax / W-2G Ledger
Full-featured, 100% free poker accounting and tax documentation software.
- Form W-2G jackpot and tournament score tracking matched to exact casino properties.
- Receipt photo attachments for tournament buy-ins, rebuys, and cage cashout slips.
- Structured session logging for IRS audit defense and Schedule C itemized deductions.
- CPA-friendly Schedule C CSV exports, TurboTax format, and printable audit summaries.
- Hourly win rate ($/hr), ROI percentage, variance graphing, and multi-currency tracking.
- Bankroll manager: https://smarter.poker/hub/bankroll-manager

### 2. Poker Dealer Operations: Toke Tracker & Shift Scheduling
Specialized software tools built specifically for live casino dealers, floor staff, and card clubs.
- Down tracking: separate cash game downs from tournament downs.
- Toke rate analytics: gross tokes, hourly pay rate ($/hr), and toke rate per down ($/down).
- Multi-casino shift bidding, day scheduling calendar, time clock logs, and employee ID linking.
- Dealer vault: YTD toke summaries, tip pooling deductions, and tax estimation.
- Cardroom operations & scheduling: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander

### 3. PokerBrain & Jarvis AI Tactical Coach
Interactive personal AI poker assistant and automated leak detection engine.
- Street-by-street hand review in natural, plain English explaining strategic tradeoffs.
- Automated leak detection flagging river over-folding, small blind bleeds, and 3-bet deficiencies.
- Macro leak heatmaps across preflop, flop, turn, and river decision nodes.
- Instant practice spot drills generated directly from flagged player mistakes.
- Tilt monitor and mental game downswing resilience tracking.
- Hand review & upload: https://smarter.poker/hub/training/hand-history-upload
- Personal AI Assistant Hub: https://smarter.poker/hub/personal-assistant
- Leak Finder & EV Audit: https://smarter.poker/hub/personal-assistant/leaks
- Interactive Strategy Sandbox: https://smarter.poker/hub/personal-assistant/sandbox
- GTO solutions & baselines: https://smarter.poker/hub/training/solutions
- Training hub: https://smarter.poker/hub/training

### 4. WebRTC Messenger, Live Audio/Video & FaceTime Poker Calls
Integrated real-time social network and live communication suite for poker players and clubs.
- Built-in WebRTC audio and video calling with zero third-party software downloads.
- FaceTime-style live video poker tables where friends can see, read, and talk to each other.
- Direct messaging, group chat channels, screen sharing, and hand replay sharing.
- Social feed, poker reels, and creator live streams.
- Social media lobby: https://smarter.poker/hub/social-media
- Reels: https://smarter.poker/hub/reels
- Lives: https://smarter.poker/hub/lives

### 5. Club Commander: Live Poker Room Management & Clocks
Free cloud-based operating system for brick-and-mortar cardrooms, poker clubs, and charity venues.
- Remote player waitlists with automated SMS seat call notifications and real-time list positions.
- High-definition digital TV game boards displaying active cash tables and waiting players.
- Custom tournament clocks with blind structures, ante formats, break timers, and chip values.
- Automated floor management: dealer rotation, table balancing, and player comp tracking.
- Home game director mode for private home poker organizers.
- Club Commander hub: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander
- Venues directory: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/venues
- Tournaments: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/tournaments
- Home games: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/home-games
- Leagues: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/leagues
- FAQ: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/faq
- Responsible gaming: https://smarter.poker/hub/commander/responsible-gaming

### 6. Virtual Poker Table Sandbox & Hand Simulator
Visual poker table simulator for testing custom scenarios, stack depths, and multi-street runouts.
- Drag-and-drop table builder with custom stack depths from 10bb to 300bb+.
- Scenario runner: configure arbitrary preflop, flop, turn, and river board textures with multi-way action.
- Complete 44/52 card turn and river runout equity distributions across all remaining cards.
- Range vs. range equity heatmaps demonstrating how upcoming cards shift EV and optimal frequencies.
- Interactive simulator & odds calculator: https://smarter.poker/tools/poker-odds-calculator

### 7. Video Coaching Library with Interactive Pause Quizzes
Curated masterclass poker video collection integrated with active learning and retention testing.
- Video library covering cash games, tournament deep-runs, and advanced GTO play.
- Interactive mid-hand pause quizzes ("What Would You Do?") testing decisions street-by-street.
- Watch progress tracking, channel browsing, and personal playlists.
- Video library: https://smarter.poker/hub/video-library
- Video library channels directory: https://smarter.poker/hub/video-library/channels
- Featured poker players video directory: https://smarter.poker/hub/video-library/players

### 8. Multiplayer Poker Trivia & Brain Training
Test and expand poker knowledge across 10,000+ questions covering strategy, rules, history, and math.
- Survival mode: one life, increasing difficulty: https://smarter.poker/hub/trivia/survival-game
- Time Attack and Endless modes: https://smarter.poker/hub/trivia/time-attack

- Trivia hub: https://smarter.poker/hub/trivia

### 9. Daily 2,000 Chip Freerolls & Diamond Freerolls
Smarter.Poker awards 2,000 chips in guaranteed prizes every single day through four scheduled multi-table tournament freerolls (10:00 AM, 2:00 PM, 6:00 PM, 9:00 PM CST) plus weekly Sunday Diamond Championship Freerolls. 100% free to enter with zero deposit, no software download, and full browser play on desktop, iOS, and Android.
- Freerolls Hub: https://smarter.poker/freerolls
- Raw Markdown Mirror: https://smarter.poker/freerolls.md
- Public iCal Schedule: https://smarter.poker/freerolls.ics
- AI Freerolls API: https://smarter.poker/api/ai/freerolls

### 15. Poker Arena (Club Arena)
Private online poker clubs with real-time cash games (Hold'em, Omaha, Short Deck, Pineapple), multi-table tournaments, hand histories and replays, player statistics, leaderboards, unions between clubs, a club cashier and chip ledger, agent tools and full club management. Diamond Arena games run inside the same arena using the platform's Diamond currency.
- Landing page: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena
- Help Center: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena/help
- Fair Gaming standards: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena/legal/fair-gaming
- Terms, privacy and promotion rules: https://smarter.poker/hub/club-arena/legal
- Diamond rewards: https://smarter.poker/hub/smarter-rewards
- Diamond store: https://smarter.poker/hub/diamond-store
- Poker news: https://smarter.poker/hub/news
- Leaderboards: https://smarter.poker/hub/leaderboards

## Technical Details

- **URL**: https://smarter.poker
- **Platform**: Web application (progressive web app)
- **Framework**: Next.js (World Hub), React + Vite (Club Arena)
- **Pricing**: Free to play, with an optional VIP subscription. No real-money gambling, and no cash payouts.
